{{Top|leg}}
The '''Trophy Wall''' was a large exhibit located in [[Exovar's Emporium]]. It contained mementos of [[Luskin Exovar]]'s adventures, and was protected by [[Deflector shield/Legends|defensive shields]] and a [[hypersonic alarm system]]. Among the mementos on display were a full [[Imperial Royal Guard armor|Imperial Royal Guard uniform]], artwork from [[Master]] [[Furva Keill]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], and two battle-worn [[Thyrsus/Legends|Thyrsus]] [[Sun Guard]] [[Helmet/Legends|helmets]]. Visitors to the Emporium were allowed to leave their own mementos, serving as chance at immortality of their adventures.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
